README: The sound sheet. Read Topics/WhatIf/SOUND.md first. Times are cues and words, never seconds. Then: python3 scripts/sound.py build what-if-you-could-see-how-long-you-had

sections.why: The power arrives and it is wonderful: five clocks, four jokes, all of it new.
The limit, said out loud. The first bar of curious at the limit is the story saying 'but'.
He starts using it on people and gets it wrong in a way that is funny - for now.
The week he spends reading everybody and talking to nobody: quiet, watchful, wrong.
The calm day that is not calm. A pulse that will not stop, and it grows.
Ten seconds, and he runs. The music believes he can fix it, which is exactly as wrong as he is.
Nothing, for the second the answer arrives. A riser through the silence.
It was counting on me. The truth, and it is bad.
He talks to her. Understanding it late is a different note from finding it out; never turn cheerful here.
